description: This file contains helper functions for managing and finalizing attempt context engines, including bootstrap, assemble, and turn finalization logic, specific to a context engine used in an agent system.

methods.name: runAttemptContextEngineBootstrap
methods.description: Initializes and runs bootstrap procedures for the attempt context engine, including optional bootstrap and maintenance steps, with error handling and warning logs.

methods.name: assembleAttemptContextEngine
methods.description: Assembles a message context for an attempt using the context engine, based on session details and messages.

methods.name: finalizeAttemptContextEngineTurn
methods.description: Finalizes a turn in the attempt context engine, handling afterTurn or batch ingestion, error handling, and optional maintenance calls.
